messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "urinating less than usual"
set: ["urinating less than usual", "problems urinating", "patients without an ejection fraction less than 40%", "pediatric patients with glomerular filtration rate less than 30 mL/min", "low systolic blood pressure less than or equal to 120 mm Hg and greater than 100 mmHg", "prolonged hypotension is defined as a systolic blood pressure less than 90 mmHg for more than 1 hour", "resulting in a calmer, less excitable nerve circuit", "patients taking higher than recommended doses", "patients younger than 18 years old", "children younger than 6 months old", "individuals younger than 18 years old", "children younger than 12 years old", "younger than 12 years of age", "weight loss smaller than medications approved for weight loss", "individuals younger than 18 years old with breathing problems", "habit of drinking more than 2 alcoholic beverages per day"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
